BeautifulRabbit8865 That is excellent that they have acknowledged the appeal. Yes, it means you should safely be able to wait for an appeal outcome and hold off on the deposit payment for the time being with your file intact. 

Regarding waiting times, I am not entirely sure. Based on what I have seen in this group, it looks like between a couple of weeks and a couple of months - but I am not sure how the war backlog might have affected that.
